info.title: audio.liken.sh capture API
info.summary: Taps what a Sink plays and what a Source hears, and streams it as WAV, FLAC, or Ogg Opus.
info.description: Identity is in the path, the format is in the extension or in Accept, and the span is a W3C Media Fragments t= in the query. Every request carries a ServiceAccount token minted with the audience audio-api, and a tap needs get on sinks/audio or sources/audio in the group audio.liken.sh. Nothing is stored: every answer streams from the node the endpoint is on.

discovery.description: The discovery document the three capture APIs share.

endpoint.description: One endpoint's own document: the node a tap targets, the rate and channel count it would use, the format the node reports now, and the forms served.

problem.description: The RFC 9457 problem document every error answers with. detail carries the source's own words: pw-record's stderr, an encoder's stderr, or the API server's status message. instance is the request path, a number sign, and the request id the log line carries.

bearerToken.description: A ServiceAccount token minted with the audience audio-api, which this API checks with a TokenReview.

away.description: The endpoint has no status.node. The detail says to power the device on.

badGateway.description: The capture container answered something that is not HTTP or not a problem document.

badRequest.description: A t= the grammar refuses, a t=a,b with a at or after b, a begin over 60 seconds, a repeated dimension, an unknown query parameter, or a knob the format does not take.

forbidden.description: The SubjectAccessReview said no. The WWW-Authenticate header names the scope the caller would need.

gatewayTimeout.description: The capture container sent no headers within the header timeout.

methodNotAllowed.description: A method other than GET, HEAD, and OPTIONS.

notAcceptable.description: Accept excludes every representation the route serves. The acceptable member lists what it does serve, with the URI of each.

notFound.description: No Sink or Source of that name, or PipeWire holds no node for it.

notModified.description: The If-None-Match field matches this document's ETag.

unauthorized.description: No token, or a token the TokenReview refuses. The WWW-Authenticate header carries the review's own words.

unavailable.description: The capture container is at its tap limit, refused the connection, is not ready, has no certificate this API trusts, or PipeWire refused pw-record.

wrongTarget.description: The tap's link landed on a node other than the one asked for.
